title: deutzia × magnifica
intro: Deutzia × magnifica, commonly known as Deutzia, is a flowering plant belonging to the Hydrangeaceae family. This shrub is valued for its fragrant white flowers and attractive foliage, often used in ornamental gardens. The health benefits of Deutzia include its potential in soothing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
